subject: Urgent: Sentinel payment - credit flag + EU VAT triage
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-19T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Outstanding invoices + VAT evidence request (INV-2028-0472)

Hi Maria,

Following up on invoice INV-2028-0472 (EUR 87,450) — our AP team shows this as past due since 2028-05-04. You mentioned cashflow tightness last week; wanted to check status and whether Sentinel can share remittance/proof or an expected payment date.

We also see a VAT reverse-charge note on your PO. To clear our ledgers and release any holds, our tax team needs either:
- your local VAT registration that confirms reverse-charge applicability, or
- confirmation that Sentinel will remit VAT and accompanying proof.

Attachments: INV-2028-0472.pdf (invoice), payment history stub is attached for your convenience.

If helpful, we can propose a short staged payment (30% now, remainder within 45 days) while tax is sorted — but I need to know if Treasury can provide a payment ETA or the VAT docs by EOD Friday so we don’t escalate.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations (Collections)
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@sentinelhealth.com>

Cc: Sentinel Health Treasury <treasury@sentinelhealth.com>, Oliver Park <oliver@consultingpartners.co>
Date: 2028-05-19T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices + VAT evidence request (INV-2028-0472)

Hi Soojin — thanks for flagging.

Apologies for the delay. We have a partial payment in progress (30%) which should hit your account by 2028-05-21. Treasury is still validating whether the reverse-charge applies for this engagement; they asked for a short list of support docs from Redwood (contract clause, services breakdown). Oliver from our consultants looped in to expedite.

I’ve attached a remittance stub for the 30% and will share Treasury’s confirmation or VAT registration by close of business on Tuesday (2028-05-22).

Best,
Maria
Finance Manager — Sentinel Health
maria.gonzalez@sentinelhealth.com

Attachment(s): Sentinel_payment_proof_05-18.pdf (remittance stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-20T08:27:00+01:00
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding invoices + VAT evidence request — proposed next steps

Kimberly, Jonas — forwarding the thread with Sentinel. They’ve committed to 30% by 5/21 and will attempt to provide VAT confirmation by 5/22.

Recommendation and ask:
- Temporarily accept the 30% partial payment and move account to "staged remit" so product access remains unchanged.
- If Treasury cannot confirm reverse-charge by 5/22, escalate credit flag and initiate our canary dunning sequence (72-hour reminder then legal notice cadence).
- If we escalate, request approval for a one-off waiver to allow a 7-day grace extension for EU customers with pending VAT evidence (to avoid unnecessary legal steps).

I need a decision by EOB today so I can communicate next steps and avoid surprise service interruption. If you approve staged remit, I’ll log the payment plan in HubSpot and send a revised mutual action plan with Milestones: 30% by 5/21, VAT evidence by 5/22, final 70% by 6/30.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachment(s): none

Thanks for the summary, Soojin.

Approve the staged remit approach: accept the 30% as a bridge payment and pause automated service suspension. Conditions:
1) HubSpot entry with payment milestones and owner (So, please create and assign the MIP to Jonas).
2) Treasury confirmation deadline remains 2028-05-22 EOD — if not received, Collections to trigger a single formal reminder (72-hour) and escalate to legal only if there’s no response to that reminder.
3) Finance to prepare a short exception memo for accounts > EUR50k to document the one-off grace (I’ll sign).

Jonas — please coordinate with Revenue Accounting to reconcile the partial payment and apply the holding memo for VAT. Soojin — copy Legal on the 72-hour draft reminder so we have a safe template ready.

I don’t want an immediate credit freeze unless we get a hard no from Treasury after the reminder. Keep me posted.

— Kimberly
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
